column1: # Game profile of BioShock Remastered (Switch, update 1.0.2 = v65536). Plays on the Mac
# Format: see dm/games/README.md; bring-up and measurements in README.md beside this file
# Blind Squirrel's Unreal Engine 3 port of Irrational's BioShock, SDK 9, NVN. Modules main (16 MB) and sdk (5.3 MB); rtld is replaced by the host.
# The shaders are the RomFS's own cache, shadercache.nx (shader_split.py shadercache_nx): 5,557 zlib blocks joined, 20,419 keys; 8 more come from main (Phyre).
# The legal-terms pages end with the browser's close(), which dm/host/web_apple.m now answers as exit reason 4; the game then writes its own first-run save
# (FirstRun.nx) and skips those pages on later boots, so no save file is needed before the first one.
# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP
# The NPDM declares no system resource (IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false), so main sets its own heap: at most the pool less 64 MB.
# The split below is the survey's; the game boots, plays and saves with it, but it was not measured against hardware (README.md, What is open)
